_about: Bottom-of-block details. Pan-plane coords: x across (+ passenger), y forward from the rear face, z up from the pan face (0). From album photo 431 rectified (pan rail fit, see pan_rail.json) and photo 22 (bare block). Features that sit off the pan plane can't be placed exactly from a single rectified view, so they are tagged [est].

ears.src: [meas] photo 431: driver-side rail ear and its hole
[meas] photo 431: passenger-side rail ear with the large through hole

filter_pad.src: [meas] position and size from photo 431 (driver-side rear corner, faces the pan); y nudged forward so it clears the bellhousing face; boss height and ports [est]

starter_pad.src: [est] passenger-side rear corner (photos 22, 431): pad with three 3/8-16 holes, a straight pair across the crank plus the offset hole, as Chevy blocks are drilled for both starter patterns

pump.src: [est] oil pump on the rear main cap: one 7/16 stud into the cap bottom, outlet through the cap into the block with an O-ring at the joint (photo 22 shows the O-ring between the driver-side studs)

windage_studs.src: [meas] photo 431: the inner studs on caps 3 and 4 are long windage-tray studs; extension [est]
